provinceTextScope: Bataan; remaining 38 iNaturalist links from GBIF stateProvince text-filter screen after the 16-record Ilanin Bay subset
question: Do the other 38 Bataan-filtered iNaturalist observations resolve a named waterbody or a reusable, taxon-matched species photo?

snapshot.retained: The broader 251-row GBIF candidate search; coordinates remain only in ignored local storage.

summarySnapshot.retained: Aggregate and non-obscured broad place/taxon/photo-license metadata only; no observation IDs, exact coordinates, usernames, photo URLs, or media files.

otherNotablePlaceText.administrativeTextMismatch: One record linked by the GBIF Bataan text screen has public iNaturalist place_guess “All Hands Beach, Olongapo, Zambales, PH”; this is an administrative-label conflict, not a polygon test.

interpretation.decision: Twelve non-obscured observations have Subic Bay place text (across spelling/label variants), but GBIF locality and waterBody are blank for all 38. Treat Subic Bay only as a marine source-discovery lead, not as a capture-station assignment or complete fish list. The province-text query also includes one place_guess naming Olongapo, Zambales, demonstrating that this filter cannot define Bataan coverage. Seven obscured/private records were not examined for place text. Of 59 attached photo-license entries, 55 are CC BY-NC and four CC0; no media was viewed or matched to taxa, so none is an app asset.

limitations: GBIF stateProvince=Bataan is indexed administrative text, not a provincial polygon query; the Olongapo, Zambales place label is a record-level textual inconsistency that needs geography review, not proof of a location.
The 12 Subic Bay mentions are broad place_guess/verbatimLocality labels; source rows provide no locality or waterBody value and no exact collection site or boundary was validated.
Seven observations marked obscured/private were excluded before reading any place text; their location was not inferred.
Research Grade and zero listed identification disagreements are platform metadata, not independent species identification or proof of a wild occurrence.

The 59 photo-license fields comprise 55 CC BY-NC and four CC0; exact media and species-to-image matching were not reviewed. No image was downloaded, visually checked, or admitted under the Bangwit species-image standard.
This text screen is not a species checklist; unreturned taxa do not support absence.
nextStep: Continue Bataan with the 66 NMNH/iBOL material-sample candidates; prioritize original collection/capture context and any linked voucher/taxon evidence. Keep the 12 Subic Bay text mentions research-only and species images behind per-image taxon, visual-standard, and rights review.

sources.supports: The bounded Bataan coordinate-screen result, dataset links, source locality fields, and administrative text filter.
Current public metadata for the remaining 38 linked observation records and record-level photo-license codes.
iNaturalist explanation that observation and image licenses are separate.

disposition.decision: Hold all 38 as research candidates; use Subic Bay only as a search lead, not as a verified waterbody occurrence or image asset.
